Class HttpMethod

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.api.io.net.http.HttpMethod
public final class HttpMethod extends Object
Named HTTP methods for matching against HttpServer.method(). Like HttpStatus, these are ordinary compile-time-constant fields, not a new intrinsic or type: a static final String initialized from a literal is itself a Java compile-time constant, so javac inlines it at every use site — method.equals(HttpMethod.GET) compiles to exactly the same bytecode as method.equals("GET").
